Capability.description:
A tool an agent can call, as its provider declares it.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the name isn't of :data:`NAME`'s form, the version isn't of
        :data:`VERSION`'s, the description is empty, or a limit isn't a setting's key.

description.description: What it does, for the agent that picks it and the person who approves it.
description.title: Description

effects.description: What a call does that taint reads.
effects.title: Effects

gate.description: The integration and the grantr action that gate it.

input_schema.description: The JSON Schema of its arguments.

limits.description:
The keys of the settings that limit it (lattice ADR-0030), such as
``calls-per-hour:mcp-github``.
limits.title: Limits

name.description: Its provider, a dot and its tool: ``artifactr.edit_text``, ``mcp.github.create_issue``.
name.title: Name

output_schema.description: The JSON Schema of its output, or None if it declares none.

provider.description: The kind of provider that offers it.
provider.title: Provider

reversibility.description: Whether a call can be undone.
reversibility.title: Reversibility

risk_class.description: A risk class beyond its tier, if it has one.
risk_class.title: Risk Class

version.description: The tool's own semantic version: a new input field is a minor version.
version.title: Version

Capability.title: Capability

Gate.description:
What gates a capability: the integration it needs on, and the grantr action it needs.

Raises:
    ValueError: If ``integration`` isn't an integration key, or ``action`` isn't of
        :data:`ACTION`'s form.

action.description: The grantr action the caller must hold, such as ``artifactr:edit_artifact``.
action.title: Action

different_approver.description: Whether an approval of a call must come from someone other than the caller.
different_approver.title: Different Approver

integration.description: An integration's key (lattice ADR-0027), or None for a capability always installed.
integration.title: Integration

Gate.title: Gate

NotExposed.description:
A command no outside client reaches, and why: what the parity test asks of it.

Raises:
    ValueError: If the reason is empty.

reason.description: Why it isn't a tool or a resource: "approvals come from a person".
reason.title: Reason

NotExposed.title: NotExposed

description: lattice's commands contract: an action a person can take in portalr, as an RFC-0011 capability with the toolset, exposure, route, resource and surfaces every surface offers it by.

capability.description:
The capability it is: its name, version, schemas, tier, effects, reversibility, gate,
limits and risk class (lattice RFC-0011). Its description is written for a model choosing a
tool.

exposure.description: How an outside client reaches it, or why none does.
exposure.title: Exposure

resource.description:
The URI template of a read exposed as a resource, such as
``artifactr://{tenant}/{workspace}/artifacts/{artifact_id}``.
resource.title: Resource

route.description:
portalr's path for a link to what it acts on, such as
``/t/{tenant}/w/{workspace}/threads/{thread_id}``, or None for none.
route.title: Route

surfaces.description: The surfaces it is offered on: every one, unless it is portalr's alone or the like.
surfaces.title: Surfaces

tenant_wide.description:
Whether it acts on the tenant as a whole, such as listing its workspaces or granting a
role, rather than in one of its workspaces: it is called with a scope that names no
workspace, and a surface asks its caller for none (lattice ADR-0044).
tenant_wide.title: Tenant Wide

toolset.description: The one toolset it is offered in.
toolset.title: Toolset

title: lattice.commands 1.1.0
